subject: Part5 Summary - Intensity threshold and acceleration metric / GGIR 1.11 versus GGIR 2.0 (test version)

messages.author: c2b608cf1a4e77a3
messages.subject: Part5 Summary - Intensity threshold and acceleration metric / GGIR 1.11 versus GGIR 2.0 (test version)
parts:
Hi everyone,

In my current study, I included acceleration metrics other than ENMO (e.g., LFENMO, BFEN) for exploratory porpuses. As you can see in my code, the same MVPA threshold was set to part2 and part5. I observed that part2, but not part5, thresholds were applied on ENMO.
As the GGIR manual also states "Threshold is applied to the first metric in the milestone data, so if you have only specified do.ENMO == TRUE then it will be applied to ENMO", may I assume that the threshold was applied on BFEN?

I tried to run the same script in the GGIR2.0 (under development version) and the part5 intensity estimates changed. Can you confirm if threshold arguments changed in this version?

Thank you for the support,

g.shell.GGIR(#-------------------------------
             # General parameters
             #-------------------------------
             mode=c(1,2,3,4,5), 
             datadir="D:",  
             outputdir="D:/SIM1",
             overwrite = TRUE,
             do.imp=TRUE,
             idloc=1,
             print.filename=TRUE,
             printsummary=TRUE,
             storefolderstructure = FALSE,  
             do.parallel = FALSE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 1 parameters:
             #-------------------------------
             do.enmo = TRUE,
             do.lfenmo = TRUE, 
             do.enmoa = TRUE, 
             do.anglez=TRUE,
             do.en = TRUE, 
             do.bfen = TRUE, 
             do.hfen = TRUE, 
             do.hfenplus = TRUE,         
             chunksize=1, 
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 2 parameters:
             #-------------------------------
             strategy = 1, 
             hrs.del.start = 0,
             hrs.del.end = 0,  
             maxdur = 7, 
             includedaycrit = 16, 
             M5L5res = 10, 
             winhr = c(5), 
             qwindow=c(0,24),   
             mvpathreshold =c(100.4, 200.6), 
             epochvalues2csv = TRUE, 
             bout.metric=1,
             do.imp=TRUE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 3 parameters: 
             #-------------------------------
             timethreshold= c(5), 
             anglethreshold=c(5), 
             ignorenonwear = TRUE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 4 parameters:
             #-------------------------------
             excludefirstlast = FALSE, 
             includenightcrit = 16, 
             def.noc.sleep = c(1),
             loglocation=c(), 
             outliers.only = FALSE,
             criterror = 4,
             relyonsleeplog = FALSE,
             sleeplogidnum = TRUE, 
             colid=1, 
             coln1=2,
             do.visual = TRUE,
             sleeplogidnum=TRUE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 5 parameters:
             #-------------------------------
             threshold.lig = c(44.8, 35.6, 36, 32.9), # (Hildebrand 2016 / Migueles 2018 / Kim 2017 )
             threshold.mod = c(100.6, 201.4, 370), # (Hildebrand 2014 / Kim 2017)
             threshold.vig = c(428.8, 707.0), # (Hildeband 2014)
             boutcriter = 0.8,
             boutcriter.in = 0.9, 
             boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
             boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8,
             boutdur.in = c(10,20,30), 
             boutdur.lig = c(1,5,10), 
             boutdur.mvpa = c(1,5,10),
             timewindow = c("WW"),
             #-----------------------------------
             # Report generation
             #-------------------------------
             do.report=c(2,5),
             visualreport = TRUE,
             dofirstpage = TRUE, 
             viewingwindow = 2)

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Part5 Summary - Intensity threshold and acceleration metric / GGIR 1.11 versus GGIR 2.0 (test version)
parts:
Hello,

The part5 uses the metric specified in the "acc.metric" parameter (by default ENMO). 

Best,
Jairo
